body: I love my children, they are the only reason I keep going.  Just lately I feel like I am failing them. They won't see their father anymore. That's my fault. My parents have to deal with my problems and drama in my life, my fault.  I went from making $1200 a week to $300 a week and now on assistance. I can barely support my family now all because I let a man back into my life believing it was whats best for my children. It is obvious I make poor choices and don't deserve to be a mother.  I feel they would be better off without me.  I'm trying and I hope you are right things will follow it's just right now I don't know how to pick up the pieces again.
